Yggdrasil.hypothesis: Learned inverse transfer failure is due either to nonidentifiable/noise-sensitive task-level inverse fits or to representational misspecification, not the unchanged bounded causal scorer.
measurements: 24 public samples per task; true corrupted-output count and FIT/CHECK partition
GF2 17-column rank of 20 FIT public input vectors, independent of true inverse
number of distinct full-rank 17-demo subsets, optimal in-FIT bit mismatch, public CHECK wrong-bit count, task coefficient agreement with source inverse only in evaluator
separately on affine and Feistel task identities: normal versus forced decode paired FP/FN
source-only per-edge inverse Hamming error histogram; oracle-only AG ceiling; exact same 7+9 cognition limit
explicit transient inference and RANSAC compute/memory ledger
Yggdrasil.candidate_admission: Diagnostic-only no parameter selection and NO DEV in this gate. Strongest source-blind learned control + evaluator-only true inverse ceiling. Original AS frozen (mode robust_affine_syndrome budget3 check56); no retrospective retuning.

Wingless.hypothesis: False positives may persist because original 12-bit 4x3 checksum conflates distinct causal inputs or because original score lacks discriminative signals even with unambiguous packed codes.
Wingless.candidate_selection: Exactly two alternate deterministic 12-bit checksum parameterizations frozen BEFORE TRAIN. Same original score logic. No graph truth or source operator enters predictor. 16-bit oracle overcapacity is diagnostic only and inadmissible.
metrics: FP/FN/paired on all new source TRAIN pairs, by graph family and causal depth
number of on-edge distinct raw 16bit patterns colliding as 12bit codes for each checksum
signed score deltas per individual positive and negative source case
all original gamma0 accepted 13-15 hop positives must survive individually
max 64 nodes, exactly one 12bit retained packet per node, no cached second path; cpu/operation costs for each arm
Wingless.DEV_admission: A 12bit candidate must strictly reduce FP, maintain original paired sensitivity and retain every original-accepted long positive. No DEV consumption in F124-AT, even if TRAIN is positive; a separate immutable selected config plus independent preflight is required.
